'''Raw rancor-beast liver''' was the edible [[Liver/Legends|liver]] of the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]].<ref name="POTDS">[[Prophets of the Dark Side (novel)|''Prophets of the Dark Side'']]</ref>

It was served on [[Scardia Station]] by the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]], led by the [[Rajah Ubooki|Kadann]], to [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure|Zorba the Hutt]].<ref name="POTDS" />
